en: Colorized historic postcard showing a large, ornate stone government building with rusticated walls, arched windows fitted with striped awnings, and a dark roof. The building occupies a whole block, with a cobblestone street and small landscaped garden areas surrounding it. In the top left corner the caption appears in two languages identifying the building in Riga.
